ios.rationale: The complete mobile release/install instructions offer the Android APK and omit an iOS release.

mobile-web.rationale: The Android controller is a Flutter app with android and ios folders only and the gateway serves JSON and WebSocket routes; no phone-browser interface exists in the source.

claude-code.rationale: Named CLI family; provider-specific queue/recovery restrictions retained.

codex.rationale: Named CLI family; provider-specific queue/recovery restrictions retained.

gemini-cli.rationale: Named CLI family; provider-specific queue/recovery restrictions retained.

opencode.rationale: Named CLI family; provider-specific queue/recovery restrictions retained.

pi.rationale: Named CLI family; provider-specific queue/recovery restrictions retained.

grok.rationale: Named CLI family; provider-specific queue/recovery restrictions retained.

cursor.rationale: Named CLI family; provider-specific queue/recovery restrictions retained.

antigravity.rationale: Claude Codex Bridge v8.7.21 ships an agy provider with pane-backed execution, native session-log completion, resume and workspace attachment. The Antigravity adapter reports observed session completion rather than exact completion and does not support stream-watch.

aider.rationale: The provider registry is a fixed in-code list of 21 names without Aider, there is no custom adapter loader, and a repository-wide search for aider found no match.

local.rationale: Current execution host. Re-attested 2026-11-08 after an independent cross-check correction to claude-codex-bridge:RUN-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

own-server.rationale: Android controls available CCB server projects. Re-attested 2026-11-08 after an independent cross-check correction to claude-codex-bridge:RUN-01; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

vendor-cloud.rationale: No vendor-operated agent execution: agents run on the user host and the official relay only forwards encrypted envelopes; bounded search found no provisioning or sandbox-host code.

container.rationale: The inspected built-in launch path uses terminal processes and Git worktrees without provisioning this isolation option. User-installed agent sandboxing is separate.

vm.rationale: The inspected built-in launch path uses terminal processes and Git worktrees without provisioning this isolation option. User-installed agent sandboxing is separate.

license.rationale: Declared AGPL-3.0, without an established or-later grant; commercial wording preserved.

self-hosting.rationale: Core TUI/daemon/gateway run on owned host.

free-tier.rationale: Explicit free-use statement in root license summary.

starting-price.rationale: Free CCB use; model and host costs separate.

byo-subscription.rationale: Source inspection: provider profiles inherit the native CLI authentication by default; release notes cover Claude OAuth and Grok logins. Not tested. Scope: CCB v8.7.21 terminal workspace.

macos.rationale: Native CLI/TUI support, not a GUI app. Linux/macOS are normal installs; Windows x64 is a publicly available unsigned beta with the documented prerequisites.

windows.rationale: Native CLI/TUI support, not a GUI app. Linux/macOS are normal installs; Windows x64 is a publicly available unsigned beta with the documented prerequisites.

linux.rationale: Native CLI/TUI support, not a GUI app. Linux/macOS are normal installs; Windows x64 is a publicly available unsigned beta with the documented prerequisites.

coordinator.rationale: CCB ships /ask delegation and returned-result queues for its configured agents. The product supplies the communication protocol; optional specialist role packs are not required for message handoffs.

issue-tracking.rationale: Shipped product CLI commands create and update persistent tasks with state independently of chat/session lists.

unattended-triggers.rationale: The enabled maintenance heartbeat consumes a timed schedule and can activate its assessor without a human starting each diagnostic run. Scope is maintenance only.

roles.rationale: Bounded gateway, config UI and CLI inspection establishes device scopes and revocation, without human organization/workspace roles. Agent roles are distinct.

sso.rationale: The scoped native application authenticates through local tokens/device pairing; inspected authentication code contains no SSO provider integration.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Bounded source inspection found no CCB telemetry-disable control. This does not claim that core telemetry is enabled, and excludes provider CLI telemetry.

byok.rationale: Native agent profile configuration accepts the user's own provider API keys. This establishes BYOK independently of the undisclosed CCB commercial-license price.

web-client.rationale: Bounded inspection of the v8.7.22 tree: the only browser interface is the loopback Config UI for configuration; no browser session client exists, and the product describes the phone app as the remote controller.

multiplayer.rationale: CCB models paired devices of one project owner, not users: no accounts, presence, attribution or sharing; searches for multi-user, collaborator and co-editing terms found none.

pr-workflow.rationale: Git operations are local commit, merge, fast-forward and reset for workgroup integration; searches for pull request, gh pr and GitHub API use found only release checks.

review-ui.rationale: No product interface shows code diffs for review: the only unified diff is a Config UI settings diff and the mobile terminal view colours raw terminal output.

laptop-independent.rationale: Scoped to user-owned hosts: the project daemon and tmux panes run on the host independent of the client, and CCB Mobile attaches to the same running agents from another device; there is no vendor cloud mode.
